project_type: Multi-language runtime code-execution explanation framework. Rust core engine with language bindings (PyO3 Python, Neon Node, JNI Java, FFI C, CGO Go), a CLI, and a tokio-based web dashboard.
build_system: Cargo workspace (resolver 2). Root Cargo.toml is [workspace] only (no [package]). Members: xplainit-core, xplainit-python, xplainit-node, xplainit-c, xplainit-java, xplainit-cli, xplainit-dashboard. Release profile sets lto=true, codegen-units=1, strip=true, and panic="abort" (IMPORTANT: panic=abort means std::panic::catch_unwind will NOT catch panics in release builds; graceful-degradation work in Task 4.2 must account for this).
test_framework: Rust: built-in #[test] / #[tokio::test]; integration tests in xplainit-core/tests/integration_tests.rs and xplainit-cli/tests/cli.rs; benches dir does NOT yet exist. Python: plain scripts run with the interpreter (no pytest): test_automatic_tracing.py (repo root), xplainit-python/test_frame_filter.py, xplainit-python/test_depth_accounting.py, xplainit-python/test_decorators.py.
test_command: cargo test  (full workspace). Full gate set: cargo build --release && cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check. Then Python suites: from repo root with venv active (source .venv/bin/activate): python test_automatic_tracing.py; and from inside xplainit-python/: python test_frame_filter.py, python test_depth_accounting.py, python test_decorators.py (these require the maturin-built module: cd xplainit-python && maturin develop --release, module name 'xplainit').
verification_instructions: After every feature, keep the whole workspace green: (1) cargo build --release, (2) cargo test (expect >=178 tests, 0 failures), (3) cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (exit 0), (4) cargo fmt --all -- --check (exit 0), (5) all four Python suites pass (3/3, 11/11, 23/23, decorators pass). For Task 4.5, additionally: cargo doc --all --no-deps must build with ZERO warnings (currently clean; keep it clean). New Rust code must ship with revert-sensitive tests (a test that fails if the code under test is reverted).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The Python module is built with maturin (cd xplainit-python && maturin develop --release) and is not committed. cargo doc output under target/doc is not committed.
setup_instructions: Rust toolchain 1.92 present. For Python: source .venv/bin/activate; cd xplainit-python && maturin develop --release (module name 'xplainit'). gcc 11.5, clang 15, JDK 25, go 1.25.1 present. node/npm ABSENT (only bun 1.2.14).
environment_constraints: Network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (repository access only). Installing NEW crates/tools from crates.io or other registries will FAIL. CONFIRMED UNAVAILABLE (verified with `which`): cargo-audit, cargo-tarpaulin, cargo-fuzz, mdbook, cargo-outdated, cargo-vet, cargo-flamegraph. Do NOT attempt to install these; do NOT fabricate their output. Implement the underlying intent by available means (hand-rolled property-style and edge-case tests instead of proptest/cargo-fuzz since NEITHER proptest NOR quickcheck is in Cargo.lock; manual cargo doc build instead of mdbook; hand-written Markdown user guide under docs/ instead of an mdbook book; version pinning + Cargo.lock review instead of cargo audit). Adding a NEW dependency requires it to already be resolvable from Cargo.lock / local cache; prefer std-only and existing workspace deps. node/npm absent so xplainit-node cannot be rebuilt via npm.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch phase4-production-hardening. Coder commits each feature on the branch as it completes (orchestrator fast-forward-merges into master; NO pull requests). Neither planner nor coder pushes or merges. If any work is left uncommitted, it must be reported with exact paths. Do not overstate completion: where a sub-item depends on an unavailable offline tool, implement the intent by available means, run what CAN run, and document precisely what is blocked and why.
key_patterns: RuntimeControl (xplainit-core/src/control.rs) is the central enable/disable + panic_mode mechanism using Arc<AtomicBool>/AtomicU64; safe_execute() wraps closures in catch_unwind and calls enter_panic_mode() on panic (NOTE: ineffective under panic=abort release profile). There is currently NO circuit-breaker (repeated-error counting -> auto-disable) and NO framework-error telemetry counter. Config (xplainit-core/src/config.rs) has NO secrets/redaction concept. Events (xplainit-core/src/events.rs) capture runtime values via the Value enum, including named `arguments: HashMap<String,Value>`, variable old/new values, return_value, exception values, etc. -- redaction should hook where named values are captured/formatted (e.g., redact values whose key matches secret-like names such as password/token/secret/api_key). Dashboard (xplainit-dashboard/src/main.rs + http.rs) serves ONLY fixed static routes (/, /style.css, /app.js, /summary, /callgraph, /timeline, /tasks, /events) with assets embedded via include_str! -- there is NO dynamic path-based file serving, so classic static-file path traversal is not present; it already caps request-head size (MAX_REQUEST_HEAD_BYTES=64KB), enforces a 15s READ_TIMEOUT, and rejects non-GET. The trace file path comes from a clap CLI arg (xplainit-dashboard and xplainit-cli). unsafe is concentrated in xplainit-c (23 occurrences, FFI) and xplainit-java (10, JNI); xplainit-core/cli/dashboard/node/python/go have 0 unsafe in non-test code. No proptest/quickcheck/arbitrary in Cargo.lock. No benches/ dir. No docs/ dir. cargo doc --all --no-deps currently builds clean (0 warnings).
